name: 53085 · Sheboygan Fls, WI
findings: ZIP 53085 (Sheboygan Fls) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53085 (Sheboygan Fls) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53085 (Sheboygan Fls) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
